layer_model: 21 routing heights = 19 body planes + 2 routable interface planes; one body plane per route

layer_stack.note: 21 routing heights: body layers 2..20 (ids contiguous; plane 20 has z=-0.05, NOT above L19) + the two routable interface rows of L1 (ids 1001/1002).  The l3d stack keeps interface layer L1 with rows z1=0.0 / z2=0.5; physical ordering is always taken from z, never from the id.
layer_stack.provenance_note: exploratory simulation input; never reported as a formally accepted process condition

process.same_layer_2d_rules: original strict D56 index (width 0.05 + edge gap 0.03); legal transverse crossings preserved
process.transition_geometry: two exact R=15 mm circular arcs in the vertical plane of the local inward direction (G1 S-curve)
process.different_physical_planes: legal when |dz| >= 0.05 mm; XY overlap alone is not a violation
process.transition_vs_other: true 3D centre-line distance must be >= 0.05 mm

explicitly_not_restored.note: the unconfirmed 80 um global clearance is NEVER restored as a 3D rule; 0.08 mm only survives as the same-layer 2D centre-line rule of the original D56 geometry

unconfirmed.surface_process_margin: not verified; the boundary waveguides only satisfy the current exploratory centre-line model

process.interface_body_routing_rule: the Z1_INTERFACE (z=0.0) and Z2_INTERFACE (z=0.5) heights are routable 2D body planes in this experiment: a route whose target height equals its own interface height is DIRECT (0 transitions, no lead, no S-curve) and its body is a flat part at that height; it must pass the same strict D56 rule against every interface lead at the same height and true-3D >= 0.05 mm against every S-transition sample of other routes
process.baseline_process_rules_note: baseline 18-layer values are inherited unchanged from common.process_rules_payload() except the documented 21-height overrides

native_3d.model: multi-height bodies with mid-body R15 layer changes (Phase 2)

crossing_definition: every flat part grouped by its physical z; fslw strict D56 audit (identical to the freeze baseline)
